issues.title: Better rendering of messages
issues.body:
Besides plain chat, some messages get sent in a structured format.

Here is an example of a structured message:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123140376-226ce980-d44f-11eb-8d0a-82472b7e4b95.png)

Serge does it's best to render this content in a tidy way, but it's not great:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123140454-37497d00-d44f-11eb-8a5f-3989f747ed64.png)


We have these issues:
* [x] doesn't render `true`, it's blank. We should use a tick or cross character if the value isn't a string, but is a boolean
* [x] omits title of composite components. In the data we have `Consumption` and `Location` elements. These aren't rendered. They should be. 
* [x] Object hierarchy is hidden.  For parent objects (arrays or objects) we should show the name larger, more bold, something more distinctive.
* [x] Rendering fails on a boolean value (see `Spare field 2`)
* [ ] label can get separated from the value, sometimes on the next line. We should try to "wrap" the label & value with a line border - and see what that looks like.  The label & value are currently separate spans, we'd have to wrap them in a parent span/div.

Step to reproduce above issue:
* open Serge
* open `tall msg` game
* login as `Game Control`
* expand `Weather Forecast`

The logic for the above is in `channel-message-detail\index.tsx`. There is a StoryBook to demonstrate the actions.

Run `yarn storybook` then open the `Channel Message Detail` story.  The `Weather Forecast` contains the detail for this issue.
